It argued, very politely, that quiet students never ask questions and so never learn anything. The teacher read it twice, tried not to smile, and failed."

items.stem:

It argued, very politely, that quiet students never ask questions and so never learn anything. The teacher read it twice, tried not to smile, and failed."

Answer the following:
(i) Why was Kabir given an extra assignment?
(ii) What did Kabir argue in his page?  (a) That teachers talk too much  (b) That he would never talk again  (c) That quiet students never ask questions and so never learn  (d) That maths is useless
(iii) What does "tried not to smile, and failed" tell us about the teacher?
(iv) Which word best describes Kabir's argument?  (a) angry  (b) witty  (c) rude  (d) dull
items.answer: (i) Because he had talked through the whole lesson. (ii) (c) That quiet students never ask questions and so never learn (iii) He found the clever argument funny and had a sense of humour. (iv) (b) witty
items.markingKey: (i) Because he had talked through the whole lesson. (ii) (c) That quiet students never ask questions and so never learn (iii) He found the clever argument funny and had a sense of humour. (iv) (b) witty (1 mark each, 4 marks.)
